tables.name: booking_details
tables.description: The rest of the booking beside K-04's head row: one row per booking, written with the head when the request comes in (A3-51, B3-40; the owner's BOOK, A3-19, B3-08; a walk-in, A3-20). It holds the door the request came in by, the booking number the customer's own AI gets, the booking values K-01's path model reads (madeby, approval, timing, times, taken), the need-by date, who meets the pro (flow B), when the first chat link was given and the pro was told, the upset count, and how a request that was never booked ended. Each written-once value is set once, when it is decided, and never changed after (FS lines 750, 752; README rule 6, trigger booking_details_set_once). The head's columns (stage, flow, booker, person served, payer, private, deceased, version) stay K-04's and are not repeated here.
tables.source: 02-contracts section 7 row K-30 ('The rest of the booking (the head row is in core): source door ..., made by, approval, timing, times, privacy, reach, ...'); FS line 729 (booking); FS line 752; K-04 v1 bookings (the head row, CQ-03); K-01 v1 bookingValues; SPEC-master 5e; S13-57

columns.name: number
columns.description: The booking number: what the customer's own AI gets for the booking, never the check-in code (A6-14: 'The AI gets a booking number, but not the code'; FS line 675), and what the customer, the owner and staff name it by. Code makes it, unique within the business, and never parses it (CQ-09). Set when the row is written; never changed.
columns.source: A6-14; B6-13; FS line 675 ('It gets a booking number, never the code, a street address or a card'); CQ-09

columns.name: door
columns.description: How the request came in: ai (the customer's own AI, A3-02, B3-02), page (the business's booking page, A3-04, B3-07), chat (the person's own chat with Rosie's number, such as '1 Book it' to a waitlist spot, A4-60), business (the business books it, by text or on the portal, A3-19, B3-08) or walk_in (flow A, A3-20). A phone call, a voicemail and an AI on a call are out: there is no voice provider (Q-05; 01-inventory C-231, C-232). Set when the row is written; never changed.
columns.source: FS line 729 ('source door (AI, page, call, voicemail, business)'); 02-contracts section 7 row K-30 ('source door (AI, page, business, walk-in; call and voicemail out)'); A3-01, B3-01; A4-60; Q-05

columns.name: approval
columns.description: now (it books on the yes) or ownerok (a request the owner OKs first: 'This is a request: Lee's Barbershop answers by 11:20am tomorrow'), decided once at A4-98 (B4-115) from the owner's OK rules (K-26 ok_same_day, ok_new_customer, ok_dates) and followed by A6-01 (B6-03), never decided again. A booking the business adds is now (A4-98). Null until decided: a step reading it before then reads K-01's first value, now. Set once.
columns.source: FS line 752 (approval, written once); K-01 v1 bookingValues.approval (expert cut by record.live.off); A4-98, B4-115; A6-01, B6-03; K-26 v1 rule kinds ok_same_day, ok_new_customer, ok_dates

tables.name: booking_visits
tables.description: Each visit of a booking: the one visit of most bookings, and each day of a multi-day job or each visit of a series booked as one (A7-01: 'Each later day the customer comes in gets its own reminder, with a new code'; A7-05). It names the visit's reservation, whose during is the booked time itself (K-04 reservations), and holds the arrival window or sent-now estimate, the free-cancel time and the check-in code, new each visit and sealed. Written when the booking is written (A6-10, B6-10). A move points it at the new reservation and moves its window and free-cancel time, with a booking_changes row; the code never changes ('The code stays the same: it's still the same visit', A7-03).
tables.source: 02-contracts section 7 row K-30 ('start, end, arrival text, ... check-in code (new each visit), free-cancel time'); FS line 729 (start, end, arrival text, check_in_code, cutoff_at); A6-10, A6-14; A7-01, A7-03, A7-05; K-04 v1 reservations

Null: no free-cancel time (a job sent now: free cancel ends at the on-my-way text, B4-91).

tables.name: page_answers
tables.description: What a person typed on the booking's secure page: the plug-in's questions that change neither the time nor the price, the open note for the pro, access and door notes, an entry code, a health need that keeps someone safe, an emergency contact where the plug-in asks, a child's details, the papers a booker acts under, and photos added for a quote. Secure page only: each answer is sealed under the key of the person who typed it, never in a text, an email, a call summary or a customer's AI; the job page opens it. Each answer is its own row, never edited; a newer answer of the same kind and question wins.
